entities.name: Trinity Cathedral in Pskov
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Trinity Cathedral is located in the Pskov Krom or Kremlin on the east bank of the Velikaya (Great) River. It has, since 1589, been the mother church of the Pskov Eparchy.
